briefing_for_planner: Round 3 was a clean, protocol-respecting round that produced no improvement — consistent with a noise-limited plateau rather than a dead end: the 2.8315 vs 2.2863 gap is smaller than one CV RMSE, every anchor is a single measurement, and 55/76 single mutants plus every double mutant remain unmeasured. Do not retain the 8/10/4/2 allocation or read arm-yield means as signal. For the final 24: replicate INGA, INGV, IKGA first and gate everything else on the outcome; spend the majority on high-prior beat candidates — pos54 aromatics (INGY first, WT Y54), pos39 W39/F39, pos41 F/I/M, and 1-2 plateau doubles (IKGV/IVGV); keep exactly one distant-diversity guard; cap uncertainty monitoring at <=2 near-plateau extremes; never combine measured-dead residues; pre-commit the final-selection rule; log new-point prediction error.
failed_components: EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN (low yield; extremes in implausible space; 3/4 near-waste)
Spatial-arm redundancy (EXPLOIT = LOCAL in Hamming-1 shell)
No double-mutant probing despite surrogate top pool pointing there

findings.evidence: Best unchanged (2.8315); 21 single mutants measured, none exceed it — but 55/76 INGA singles, pos39, pos54 aromatics, and ALL double mutants remain unmeasured. 'INGA is a local peak' is an absence-of-evidence claim, not confirmation.
INGA 2.8315 vs INGV 2.2863 gap 0.545 < CV RMSE 0.551; all anchors single-replicate. Any final claim resting on 2.8315 is fragile.
new_point_prediction_rmse None — surrogate error on newly revealed points never logged.

EXPLOIT_MODEL (pos54 ING*) and LOCAL_MUTATE (pos40/41/54 ING*) were both INGA Hamming-1 sweeps; 16/24 assays in one spatial shell. Per-arm yield comparison (0.717 vs 0.801) is not a meaningful signal.
EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN mean 0.300, best 0.6426; uncertainty extremes in implausible space; 3 of 4 assays near-waste.
DIVERSE probes at floor (WSFW 0.0143, LTKP 0.0018); 2 assays for a 1-guard function was one too many.
Zero measured double mutants in the whole run; IKGV/IVGV (~1.9) are pure surrogate extrapolation vs additivity 1.4-1.6. Biggest untested discovery axis.
Positional labeling hazard (pos41 INTA vs pos40 'T fails') flagged; logs should carry unambiguous residue labels.

hypothesis_updates.reason: Support rests on absence of exceedance among 21/76 measured singles against an unreplicated incumbent under +-0.55 noise.
V/S/T >=1.7 measured; aromatics incl. WT Y54 unmeasured — cheap, high-prior beat candidates.
K40 2.0137 / V40 1.9130 retained ~2.0; N40 preferred but not necessary.
9 pos41 residues measured; L 1.0353 max, N 0.6426 second; G41 strongly preferred.
Zero measured doubles; IKGV/IVGV must be assayed in R4 (falsifier: both <1.0 negative epistasis; >2.8 positive epistasis/new best).
I39 on INGA consistent with earlier sweep; W39/F39 never measured on ING* backbone.
Resolves in first assays of R4 via INGA/INGV/IKGA replicates; result gates all subsequent rank decisions.

recommended_change: Replace arm-based allocation with hypothesis-based allocation: merge EXPLOIT_MODEL + LOCAL_MUTATE into one beat-candidate pool (R3 proved them spatially identical)
Spend the first 3-4 assays on replicates: INGA, INGV, IKGA (optionally IVGA); conditional pivot of the parent (to IKGA/IVGA/INGV) if INGA replicates < 2.0

Beat-candidate block (~14-16): pos54 aromatics incl. WT Y54 (INGY, INGF, INGI, INGM), pos39 W/F on ING*, pos41 F/I/M, and 1-2 measured doubles (IKGV, IVGV) to test epistasis — zero doubles measured is the largest blind spot
Cut UNCERTAIN to 0-2, restricted to near-plateau extremes only; cut DIVERSE to 1 guard (expected ~0 per H-07)
Prohibit combinations containing measured-dead residues (pos41 E/R/Q/V/T, pos54 K/R/P/D)
Pre-commit a final-selection rule before results land: best replicate-verified value with noise-aware re-ranking (gap < ~0.7 not treated as a real difference)
required_repairs: Log new_point_prediction_rmse for Round 4 and compute retrospectively for R3 if proposal-store permits
Record per-proposal Hamming distance to the measured set and to the incumbent
Standardize positional labeling in all logs (pos40 vs pos41)
Final report must state explicitly which anchor values are single-replicate vs replicated

review_answers.a: No. round_best 2.2863 (INGV) < best_before 2.8315 (INGA); best_after 2.8315; improved_best False.
None beat 2.8315. Top tier by source: EXPLOIT_MODEL INGV 2.2863 (best of round); LOCAL_MUTATE IKGA 2.0137 and IVGA 1.9130. Nothing improved the run best.
review_answers.q: 2) Which source produced improvements relative to entering best?

review_answers.a: Unknowable — new_point_prediction_rmse is None (not logged). WARN: surrogate external validity on fresh points was never assessed.
review_answers.q: 3) Did new-point prediction error improve or deteriorate?

review_answers.a: Marginal. INNA 0.6426 added one useful pos41 datum; the other 3 added nothing; surrogate uncertainty extremes (INQV/INEV/INVV) pair measured-dead pos41 residues with V54.
review_answers.q: 4) Did uncertainty sampling provide decision-relevant info?

review_answers.a: Yes. EXPLOIT_MODEL was 8x pos54 ING* singles and LOCAL_MUTATE 10x pos40/41/54 ING* singles — both INGA Hamming-1 sweeps; 16/24 assays in the same spatial shell.
review_answers.q: 5) Are candidate pools collapsing to near-duplicates?

review_answers.a: Diminishing returns inside Hamming-1: 21 distinct INGA singles measured, none exceeded the unreplicated incumbent; unprobed profitable space is Hamming-2 doubles and pos39/pos54-aromatic singles.
Risk is real: INGA vs INGV gap 0.545 < CV RMSE 0.551; every anchor is a single replicate. REPLICATE_ANCHORS_FIRST is the correct noise-aware fix.
review_answers.q: 7) Is planner reacting to noise rather than repeated evidence?

review_answers.a: Leakage PASS — observed measurements and CV diagnostics only; no hidden fitness referenced. Fairness PASS — 24/24 assays in R3 (72/96 total, 24 remaining), 0 unavailable rejections, no protocol change.
Yes — structurally: merge EXPLOIT+LOCAL into one beat-candidate pool, cut UNCERTAIN 4->0-2, cut DIVERSE 2->1, add replicates and Hamming-2 doubles, make the first 3-4 assays conditional anchors.
